name: token-saver
description: Save tokens on three levers: output (minimum-token answers), input (command-output hygiene), context (lean persistent files).

hooks.command: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; HOOK_ROOT=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | sed 's|^/\([a-zA-Z]\)/|\1:/|'); node "$HOOK_ROOT/src/hooks/session-start.js"
